clue.text: Agile chap or eccentric finds island group

indicators.note: eccentric means odd or off-centre, telling us to rearrange the letters of the three preceding words

explanation.surface: A nimble fellow with odd habits discovers a cluster of islands.
explanation.walkthrough: 'eccentric' rearranges the eleven letters of AGILE CHAP OR; 'finds' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: An archipelago is a chain or cluster of islands, like the Hebrides or the Philippines.

clue.text: Massage youth leader becoming a deep red

parts.note: to massage is to rub

indicators.note: the leader of the word youth is its opening letter

explanation.surface: A youth worker is rubbed down until flushed crimson.
explanation.definitionFit: Ruby is the colour name for a deep, rich red, taken from the gemstone.

clue.text: This can be paid to male newsman

parts.note: he is the male pronoun
ED is short for editor, a newsman

explanation.surface: A tribute or fee might be paid to a male journalist.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a phrase completing a sentence: one pays attention, or 'pays heed'. ED for editor is a crossword staple.
explanation.definitionFit: We speak of paying attention or notice to something, and notice paid is the same idea.

clue.text: Placing on the green

definitions.meaning: golf: tapping the ball toward the hole on the closely mown area

explanation.definitionFit: Placing an object is setting it down; on a golf course's green, the stroke played is this gentle tap.

clue.text: Place officer lost occupant

indicators.note: the officer has lost the occupant, so that word is removed from it

parts.note: a lieutenant is a military officer
a tenant occupies a property

explanation.surface: An officer has lost the person living in his place.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lost' removes TENANT from LIEUTENANT, leaving the French word, used in 'in lieu of'.
explanation.definitionFit: Lieu is French for place, as in 'in lieu of', meaning in place of.

clue.text: Turns one bird into another

parts.note: goes are turns, as in having a go; the shortened plural form gos
the hawk is a bird of prey

explanation.surface: A conjuror's trick transforms one bird into a different one.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is just 'another', meaning another bird, read from the surface; 'into' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The goshawk is a large hawk of woodlands, a further species of bird beyond the first.

clue.text: Washes out the harbour leaving no sign of any stubble

definitions.text: leaving no sign of any stubble

parts.note: to wash out is to clean, here cleans
a haven is a harbour or safe anchorage

explanation.surface: Someone sluices out the port, leaving the fields bare of crop stubble.
explanation.definitionFit: A freshly shaved face has had all its whiskers removed, with no bristle left.

clue.text: One with aspiration to get on top of the world!

definitions.text: One with aspiration to get on top of the world!

parts.words: One with aspiration to get on top of the world!
parts.note: an ambitious person in a figurative sense, but literally a climber aiming to stand on a summit such as Everest

explanation.surface: A highly ambitious person yearns to rise above everyone else.
explanation.definitionFit: A climber of peaks aspires, literally, to reach the summit of the highest one on earth.

clue.text: Voice a lot discordantly

indicators.note: discordantly means out of tune or harmony, telling us to jumble the letters

explanation.surface: A singer sings a great deal, and out of tune.
explanation.definitionFit: Alto is a singing voice, the range below soprano.

clue.text: Not a present practice of being away from one's work

parts.note: someone who is not present is an absentee
an ism is a doctrine, system or practice

explanation.surface: A tradition of giving no gifts turns out to mean skipping work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not a present' tempts as a gift that was never given, but it describes a person missing; 'of' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Persistent failure to turn up for duty without good reason is this workplace term.

clue.text: Most important source of water

definitions.meaning: the pipe carrying the public water supply

explanation.definitionFit: Main means chief or principal; the water main is the large pipe supplying houses.

clue.text: A galaxy of talent?

parts.note: a galaxy is a mass of stars, and a production full of famous performers is a cluster of stars too

explanation.surface: Asks what one might call a brilliant gathering of gifted people.
explanation.definitionFit: A film or show whose performers are all celebrities is described by this phrase.

clue.text: Apt to steal

definitions.meaning: to take for one's own use without permission

explanation.definitionFit: The adjective means fitting or suitable; the verb means to take something without permission.

clue.text: Going round drinking

definitions.meaning: taking up liquid with the tongue, as a cat does

explanation.definitionFit: Racers complete circuits of a track; a cat drinks milk with its tongue in the same word.

clue.text: Billy, perhaps, takes right, old coin

indicators.note: the goat takes in the letter, holding it inside itself

parts.note: a billy is a male goat, so a billy is one example of a goat

explanation.surface: Billy, a man, grabs a right and an antique coin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'takes' puts R inside GOAT. A groat was an old English silver coin worth four pence.
explanation.definitionFit: A groat was a medieval English silver coin worth fourpence, long out of circulation.

clue.text: Pale in the South Sea city

indicators.note: the pale word goes in between the following pieces

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for south
taken as written
wan means pale

explanation.surface: Someone looks pallid down in the southern seas.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts WAN inside S + SEA. Swansea is a coastal city in south Wales.
explanation.definitionFit: Swansea is a port city on the south coast of Wales.

clue.text: Establish a good start in the tennis match

definitions.meaning: to found or put in place

definitions.text: a good start in the tennis match
definitions.meaning: a player who has won the first set is ahead

explanation.definitionFit: To set something up is to found it; a tennis player who has taken the first set leads by one set.

clue.text: Language upsets Reg with oriental monarch

indicators.note: upsets means knocks over or disturbs, so Reg and the oriental letter are jumbled together

parts.note: E is short for east, so oriental
K is short for king, a monarch

explanation.surface: A language disturbs Reg, who is with a king from the East.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upsets' rearranges REG plus E (oriental, from east) into GREE; 'with' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Greek is the language of Greece, ancient and modern.

clue.text: Type to put in order

explanation.definitionFit: The noun means a kind or variety; the verb means to arrange or classify things.

clue.text: Dim individual in the cart

indicators.note: the single letter goes in the dim word

parts.note: wan means dim or faint, as wan light
I, the Roman numeral one, a single individual

explanation.surface: A dull-witted person rides in the cart.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts I inside WAN. A wain is an old farm wagon, as in Constable's painting The Hay Wain.
explanation.definitionFit: Wain is an old word for a farm wagon, as in the painting The Hay Wain.

clue.text: A deposit Kelvin first makes isn't working

definitions.note: a verb phrase; the answer is the adjective meaning broken

indicators.note: the kelvin symbol comes first, before the other pieces

parts.note: K is the symbol for kelvin, the unit of temperature
to deposit is to put down

explanation.surface: A banker notes that a deposit made by Kelvin first is not functioning.
explanation.walkthrough: 'first' puts K in front of A PUT.
explanation.definitionFit: Kaput, from German, describes something broken and no longer functioning.

clue.text: Would such a person have difficulty in learning

definitions.text: Would such a person have difficulty in learning

parts.words: Would such a person have difficulty in learning
parts.note: someone who believes there is nothing left to learn would find it hard to take lessons

explanation.surface: Asks whether a certain type of person finds study hard.
explanation.definitionFit: A smart alec who thinks they already understand everything can learn nothing new.

clue.text: Part performed with ease, say, for the bar

indicators.note: a part performed is reworked, so its letters are rearranged
say tells us the word is spoken, giving a sound-alike

parts.note: taken as written, then heard

explanation.surface: An actor plays his role with ease, if one can say so, in the bar.
explanation.walkthrough: 'performed' rearranges PART into TRAP; 'say' turns EASE into its sound-alike EZE. 'for' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A trapeze is a horizontal bar hung on ropes, swung on by acrobats.

clue.text: Father returning to the spot to make an assignation!

indicators.note: returning means coming back, so the letters for father are written backwards

parts.note: Pa is father
a point is a spot or location

explanation.surface: A father comes back to the place to fix a meeting!
explanation.walkthrough: 'returning' reverses PA to AP. 'to' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To appoint is to fix or designate, as to name a time for a meeting.

clue.text: Student got peer agitated

indicators.note: agitated means shaken up, so the letters are mixed

explanation.surface: A student made an equal companion of his upset.
explanation.definitionFit: A protégé is a pupil guided and helped along by a mentor.

clue.text: Written authority for a large number to strike

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, a large number
to strike is to hit

explanation.surface: Written permission for many workers to go on strike.
explanation.walkthrough: C for a hundred is a standard Roman-numeral convention.
explanation.definitionFit: A chit is a short signed note or voucher, such as one authorising a payment.

clue.text: Beginner encountered outside will lose form

indicators.note: the encountered word sits outside the beginner's letter

parts.note: met means encountered
L is the learner, a beginner, from L-plates

explanation.surface: A novice meets an outsider who will lose shape.
explanation.walkthrough: 'outside' puts MET around L; 'will' is a link. L-plates mark learner drivers in Britain.
explanation.definitionFit: When something solid melts it becomes liquid and loses its shape.

clue.text: Nothing under cover in the pool

indicators.note: in a down clue the nothing letter goes beneath the cover

parts.note: a lid is a cover
O resembles zero, nothing

explanation.surface: Nothing is beneath the covering of the swimming pool.
explanation.walkthrough: 'under' puts O below LID in this down entry. A lido is an open-air public swimming pool in Britain.
explanation.definitionFit: A lido is an open-air public swimming bath.

clue.text: Wrong live broadcast

indicators.note: broadcast means scattered, so the letters of live are scattered

explanation.surface: A mistaken live transmission goes out.
explanation.definitionFit: Evil means morally bad, deeply wrong.

clue.text: Pretend to convert

definitions.meaning: to cause someone to accept a belief

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means imaginary play; split as verb plus verb it means cause someone to adopt a faith.

clue.text: Those theologians included the third son

indicators.note: the answer is included within the run of letters of the two words

explanation.surface: Those scholars of religion counted the third son among them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'included' picks letters straddling THOSE and THEOLOGIANS. In Genesis, Seth is the third son of Adam and Eve.
explanation.definitionFit: In the Bible, Seth was born to Adam and Eve after Cain and Abel.

clue.text: Shakespearean stage for everybody

definitions.meaning: Jaques in As You Like It says that this is a stage

explanation.definitionFit: Shakespeare's line in As You Like It calls the whole earth a stage; the phrase also means every person.
